entities.name: Athenian Ostracism
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Once a year, Athenian citizens could vote to exile anyone they feared was becoming too powerful. Each voter scratched a name on a pottery shard (ostrakon). If 6,000 votes were cast, the "winner" was banished for 10 years — without loss of property or citizenship. It was democracy's immune system.
